description_for_human: Search Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations metadata — tables, classes, entities, security, labels, enums, EDTs, forms, reports, queries, and models — through natural language.
description_for_model: Tools provided by the D365FO CLI MCP server backed by a local SQLite metadata index of your PackagesLocalDirectory. Supports table and field discovery (fields, relations, EDT types, indexes), X++ class hierarchy and CoC extension point analysis, data entity and DMF mapping lookup, security object inspection (duties, privileges, roles, entry points), label file search, base enum and EDT browsal, form data source and control inspection, SSRS report discovery, X++ query and view analysis, business event catalog search, integration service and data contract lookup, RunBase/SysOperation batch class discovery, and model architecture and dependency analysis. All metadata is read from the local index — no live AOS connection required.

tools.name: table_search
tools.description: Search D365FO tables by name or keyword. Returns matching table names, labels and module.

query.description: Search text — table name or keyword.

tools.name: table_get
tools.description: Get full metadata for a D365FO table: fields, EDT types, relations, indexes, delete actions and table groups.

table_name.description: Exact D365FO table name, e.g. SalesTable.

tools.name: table_find_coc
tools.description: Find Chain of Command (CoC) extension points on a table method, e.g. SalesTable::insert.

method_name.description: Table method to find Chain of Command extension points for, e.g. insert.

tools.name: class_search
tools.description: Search X++ classes by name, base class, or keyword.

query.description: Search text — class name, base class, or keyword.

tools.name: class_get
tools.description: Get X++ class metadata: methods, parameters, base class hierarchy, interfaces implemented, and existing CoC extensions.

tools.name: class_find_coc
tools.description: Find CoC extension points on a specific class method.

method_name.description: Class method to find Chain of Command extension points for.

tools.name: entity_search
tools.description: Search D365FO data entities by name, mapped table, or keyword.

query.description: Search text — entity name, mapped table, or keyword.

tools.name: entity_get
tools.description: Get data entity metadata: fields, staging table, mapped table, DMF configuration, and entity category.

tools.name: label_search
tools.description: Search D365FO label files by text string or label ID across all installed label files.

query.description: Text string or label ID to search for across label files.

tools.name: label_get
tools.description: Get the text, comment, and label file location for a specific D365FO label ID.

tools.name: security_search
tools.description: Search security objects (duties, privileges, roles, security policies) by name or keyword.

query.description: Search text — duty, privilege, or role name/keyword.

tools.name: security_get
tools.description: Get permissions, entry points, and table permissions for a security duty or privilege.

name.description: Exact security duty or privilege name.

tools.name: enum_search
tools.description: Search X++ base enums by name or keyword in the metadata index.

query.description: Search text — base enum name or keyword.

tools.name: enum_get
tools.description: Get base enum values, labels, and EDT associations for a D365FO base enum.

tools.name: edt_search
tools.description: Search extended data types (EDTs) by name or base type.

query.description: Search text — EDT name or base type.

tools.name: edt_get
tools.description: Get EDT properties: base type, extends chain, string size, enum type if applicable.

tools.name: form_search
tools.description: Search D365FO forms by name or keyword in the metadata index.

query.description: Search text — form name or keyword.

tools.name: form_get
tools.description: Get form metadata: data sources, controls hierarchy, and menu item bindings.

tools.name: query_search
tools.description: Search D365FO queries and views by name or keyword.

query.description: Search text — query or view name or keyword.

tools.name: query_get
tools.description: Get query or view definition: data sources, ranges, relations and fields selected.

query_name.description: Exact D365FO query or view name.

tools.name: business_event_search
tools.description: Search the D365FO business event catalog by name or category.

query.description: Search text — business event name or category.

tools.name: business_event_get
tools.description: Get business event metadata: payload contract fields, triggering class, and category.

tools.name: integration_search
tools.description: Search D365FO integration services, service groups, and data contracts by name.

query.description: Search text — integration service, service group, or data contract name.

tools.name: integration_get
tools.description: Get service or data contract metadata: operations, parameters, and AIF configuration.

name.description: Exact service or data contract name.

tools.name: batch_class_search
tools.description: Search RunBase, SysOperation, and batch-capable X++ classes by name or keyword.

query.description: Search text — RunBase/SysOperation/batch class name or keyword.

tools.name: batch_class_get
tools.description: Get batch class metadata: pack/unpack fields, dialog parameters, and RunBaseBatch inheritance chain.

tools.name: report_search
tools.description: Search SSRS reports by name or dataset keyword in the metadata index.

query.description: Search text — SSRS report name or dataset keyword.

tools.name: report_get
tools.description: Get SSRS report metadata: datasets, parameters, data providers, and report design names.

tools.name: model_list
tools.description: List all models in the metadata index with their layer, publisher, and version.

tools.name: model_get
tools.description: Get model descriptor: dependencies, layer, publisher, version, and object counts by type.

tools.name: index_status
tools.description: Get the current status of the D365FO metadata index: last build time, object counts, and index health.
